page.layout: One printed page, title page: centred lines of title from top to bottom, then a woodcut with a motto and date beside it, then the imprint below. No margin notes.

main_text.l: Reipub. Tigurinæ Scholam, à Carolo Magno
Quarum illa, à Carolo M. ad Reformationem, Trivialem; Hæc,
I. Bibliotheca Tigurina, sive Catalogus Librorum ante & post Refor-mationem à Tigurinis scriptorum.
II. Observationes de Collegij Carolini Origine & progressu; Doctoribus Ecclesiæ & Scholæ.
III. Judicia quædam exterorum de Schola Tigurinorum reformata.
Typis Joh. Henrici Hambergeri, impensis Joh. Henrici Wyssii : Bibliop.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the author line and the motto: allegorical figures flanking a central emblem with the inscription "Jesus Hulte Wurtelig" (partly worn). Handwritten shelf marks "IV 0 / 370" in the upper right corner are not transcribed. Date in the woodcut: MDC LXIV.
